source.plan_ref: resolve and record actual main commit containing this complete directory

cache_resolution: existing paths recorded in archived manifests
source prepare_cache in new task data directory after raw SHA match
runtime.devices: resolved by preflight; command example 0 1 is not reservation

protocol.model_buffer_rule: copy online buffers after source update; LayerNorm, no BatchNorm/Dropout

rng.gaussian_seed_derivation: int.from_bytes(SHA256(key.encode()).digest()[:8], little) & ((1<<63)-1); reuse source derive_seed, independent torch.Generator(device)
rng.probe_seed_derivation: SHA256 first8 bytes little-endian; independent generator
rng.row_hash_rule: SHA256 UTF8; least significant bit of unsigned big-endian digest assigns A=0,B=1

regular_shadows.update: once after each actual Adam step, in source operation order

pulse.group_hybrid: copy F then copy psi[group_indices] exactly; no arithmetic roundoff from F+(psi-F)

panels.rank_pairs_sampling: uniform without replacement from positive_negative Cartesian product
panels.validation_pair_fallback: all available pairs if fewer; missing class => NA
panels.train_panel_quota_shortfall: engineering data-identity diagnostic; do not pad or resample after seeing predictions

every_real_step: reduce r=theta_post_adam-F_pre_update by group before F update; aggregate without persisting step series
every_epoch: full validation online and all physical regular shadows
save selected/E10/E50 state to owned RAM
extract V_mech online/F p and logits; other H p from existing full-validation stream
pulse_anchor: 27 readouts on 3 bounded panels, reuse F
M2 full and source_detach on P_A only,6 cells each
reduce group gradient RMS and global train Macro AUC contrasts
analysis_only: temporal pair ordering change from saved online/F p for e>=2
do not count epoch/cell/readout as seed

metrics.official_auc: source FP32 model probability ordering including ties; ROC AUC
metrics.official_logloss: source float64 logs of original float32 p; max(log(p),-100), max(log1p(-p),-100); no sklearn epsilon clamp
metrics.traffic_and_pooled: retain source metrics with distinct names
M1: natural train cell logit RMS fast-F
natural train cell logit RMS slow-F
natural train cell logit RMS fast-slow
metrics.gradient_amplitude_control: norm(group g_rank_full)/sqrt(group_parameter_count); source_detach RMS also record
M3: train rank-panel exact probability AUC fast-F
train rank-panel exact probability AUC slow-F
innovation_descriptive: epoch mean/sampleSD/max of energy share with zero-denominator NA
last step instantaneous stats at pulse anchors

temporal_rank_stability.interpretation: descriptive temporal response; same-time AUC pair decomposition alone is identity, not mechanism evidence

selection.rule: strict greater-than updates best; exact tie retains earlier epoch
selection.lag_control_data: same complete Validation scalar curves, no old parameter needed
selection.peak_stability: mean available epoch +/-1 AUC minus peak, plus selected epoch dispersion; not a new checkpoint selector

history_preference_crossfit.fit: same epoch, other4seeds; choose one global H by six-cell mean, and one H per cell by its mean
history_preference_crossfit.score: same fixed epoch of heldout seed and opposite validation-row fold; no epoch search
history_preference_crossfit.aggregation: average two row folds within seed, then five-seed mean/sampleSD
history_preference_crossfit.result_identity: CELL_CONDITIONAL_DIAGNOSTIC, not a deployed single model

predictive.P_B_role: M1/M3 sample stability and M2_P_A vs observed P_B rank gain; no additional M2 gradient
predictive.target: new pulse at e+5; not delayed feedback effect of e pulse
predictive.continuous_standardization: training-fold mean and population SD (ddof0); constant=>0 flag; no score-fold fitting
predictive.skill_zero_control_MAE: NA plus absolute difference, no arbitrary epsilon
predictive.aggregation: average rows and row folds within seed, then five-seed mean/sampleSD
predictive.action_scope: one local group-readout opportunity; cannot sum into one model Macro AUC

uniform_action_control.name: UNIFORM_ACTION
uniform_action_control.fit: each dataset*objective*LOSO*row fold; select mean[0,YfastF,YslowF] over other4seeds early origins and24 supported group opportunities
uniform_action_control.score: same group opportunities of heldout seed late origins on opposite validation-row fold

predictive.action_useful_rule: five-seed heldout mean U_method-U_F >0 AND mean U_method-U_uniform >0 in a prespecified reported scope; no MAE gate
predictive.complex_information_independence_rule: M2/M3 claim of added necessity requires heldout action utility above all five simple controls; simple candidates may themselves be useful

C_CAL.trigger: in either epoch, five-seed macro mean F-online AUC and raw F-online LL have same nonzero sign
C_CAL.fit_score: fit one positive T per model/cell on V_A, score V_B, swap
C_CAL.p_endpoint_rule: p0/1 fixed, T1 returns source p exactly
C_CAL.auc_rule: retain original p ordering; compute only recalibrated LL, record numerical saturation/ties

C_BG.effect_trigger_purpose: resource priority only, not mechanism validity gate
C_BG.group_selection: rank mean abs(D_b) over triggered strata; fixed group order breaks exact ties
C_BG.apply_selected_groups: both datasets, both objectives, all5 seeds, all6 cells, both saved epochs

statistics.unit: seed paired within frozen dataset/objective/cell/group/epoch comparison
statistics.READY_rule: cross-evaluated cell/path preference or usable local pulse space AND at least one train-only method satisfies ACTION_USEFUL; simple methods eligible; report all registered scopes

test_gate.readouts: online and physical regular shadows only

guardian_cap_excludes: process overhead and IPC measured separately
resource.gpu_total_peak: measure original batch/full functional derivative smoke; do not infer from parameter bytes
resource.time_unit: cumulative worker timing including shared-resource wait; not GPU kernel time or wall clock

conditional_background: scalar metrics and state hashes only
transaction_order: atomically publish prediction and scalar index
publish epoch receipt; rollback guardian if publication failed
persistence.RAM_loss_recovery: deterministic same-job replay from theta0, verify epoch hashes, count physical cost only
persistence.release: owned anchors after S4; owned endpoints after Test; guardian after final report

stages.stop_rule: archive identities and missing observations enumerated; no rerun to confirm established EMA gains

stages.gate: independent review PASS or corrected PASS_WITH_FIXES; numerical and original-batch smoke receipts match implementation and manifest hashes

stages.stop_rule: all20 jobs and all50 epochs complete; one observation collection for stages1-3
five-seed gains, phase, lag and history preferences reported; proceed with existing S2 observations regardless of effect sign
all pulse directions, supported and structural-zero rows retained; no extra group-specific training
all prespecified folds and controls compared; issue finite control triggers; no feature search
execute each triggered fixed control once or emit NOT_TRIGGERED; no automatic expansion

stages.gate: all20 jobs complete, minimum5 seeds/condition, candidates/endpoints/comparisons frozen and hash bound

stages.stop_rule: only regular readouts selected/E10/E50; archived identical state reuse; no pulse/test tuning
answer Q1-Q5, evidence levels, limits, next decision and realized costs
release owned RAM and process state; no separate user confirmation

prohibited_expansion: new H grid or ridge HPO
